verses.text: <pb/><t>Ya Ubangiji, ina zuba ido gare ka,</t> <t>A Sama inda kake mulki.</t>
<t>Kamar yadda bara yake dogara ga maigidansa,</t> <t>Baranya kuma ga uwargijiyarta,</t> <t>Haka nan muke zuba ido gare ka, ya Ubangiji Allahnmu,</t> <t>Har mu sami jinƙanka. <pb/></t>
<t>Ka yi mana jinƙai, ya Ubangiji, ka yi mana jinƙai,</t> <t>An gwada mana wulakanci matuƙa!</t>
<t>Attajirai sun daɗe suna ta yi mana ba'a,</t> <t>Azzalumai masu girmankai sun raina mu!</t>
